correctness.rationale: Irreducibility makes A and A+I invertible. A square-zero summand has rank at most one and trace zero. A tripotent in characteristic two has eigenvalues 0,1, with a semisimple zero-primary part. Trace must be 0 or 1. With trace 1, multiplicity one for eigenvalue 1 gives rank(T)=1, impossible by rank(A)=3; multiplicity three gives T²=I, so T+I square-zero and rank(A+I)≤2, again impossible. With trace zero the identically zero primary case would give T=0, so the only target characteristic polynomial is X³+X, and this polynomial also suffices. For N=uv, square-zero is equivalent to v(u)=0. Expanding the rank-one determinant update with adj(XI−A)=X²I+XA+A²+bI gives the two other values v(Au)=b+1 and v(A²u)=c. Every nonzero u is cyclic; c≠0 ensures rank one. Scaling u cancels in uv and image lines recover the parametrization. The finite field centralizer is the multiplicative group of F_(q³), whose line stabilizers are the scalars; equivariance gives the asserted simple transitivity. The frozen checker and its finite scope were inspected, not executed. Its candidate totals also follow from (q²+q+1)(q²−1) per irreducible companion.
residual_risks: No claim about reducible cubics or additional scheme structure is verified; the arithmetic checker was not an independent all-field proof.

originality.rationale: The claimed added fiber classification, not merely existence, is mechanically implied by the explicit companion-column rule of Danchev–García–Gómez Lozano (2024), applied to the transpose with an arbitrary prescribed image line. To see this, choose φ in the dual with its values on (u,Au,A²u) equal to (0,0,1). In the cyclic basis (φ,A^tφ,(A^t)²φ) of the dual, the coordinates of evaluation at u are (0,0,1). Therefore the transpose of every rank-one update with image Ku has only a last column in this basis; conversely every nonzero such column transposes to an update with that image. Squaring to zero forces the last entry of that column to vanish. Changing the companion polynomial to X³+X now determines each entry of the unique column by Remark 2.1 itself, namely (c,b+1,0). Transposing gives v=cφ+(b+1)A^tφ, whose values are exactly the frozen ones by a=0 and Cayley–Hamilton. Thus the projective fiber, count and equivariant regular centralizer action are direct specializations and standard line counting, not an uncovered exact invariant. The trace obstruction beyond the prior binary example is an elementary rank reduction, not an independent substantive remainder. This is a scientific coverage decision, not an access failure or a claim that the literature states the projective wording verbatim.
residual_risks: No priority ordering inferred from a same-day Resultary sibling. The failure rests on a written mathematical implication from the 2024 primary proof, not on an assumed exact table.
